body:
Name of player being reported: MrGoofy
Rule broken: False report as well as intentionally trying to get someone an infraction for who knows why
Evidence: He told me specifically he was going to get me an infraction while I was trying to explain what fast hit glitch was and I got smart and decided to take some screen shots.
Anything else you would like to add? I was trying to explain fast hit glitch on control the hill to a Random and I used MrGoofy as an example. He intentionally said he would get me and infraction and then accused me of hackusating with a mod. I care about how my profile looks and how other people view me which is why I also mean to appeal another infraction that was a misunderstading with snoozin and that were cool about.

How do you insert screenshots? I have two

1 that shows him letting me know that he will get me and infracton
2 Im trying to explain to him fast hit glitch is unintentional, not hacking, and im completely fine with it
